title: Senate impeachment court gives ‘stern warning’ to Ridon over sub judice rule
summary: House prosecutor Rep. Terry Ridon said Monday that the Senate impeachment court had accepted his response to the show-cause order concerning the sub judice rule and issued him only a stern warning.
